about: The Workbench icons of the KQ drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/kq.png, a hero's sword across a shield) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files (MIT). KQ-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, KQ.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's KQ.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for COPYING; Data.info is the data, maps, scripts, Libs and User drawers' icon.
